title: Exception Hour Response
description: A date-specific operating interval or full closure. Its `valid_from`, `valid_through`, `opens`, and `closes` are local civil values interpreted in the containing Location's `timezone`. Date bounds are inclusive.

title.description: A short human-readable heading naming the exception (for example, 'Thanksgiving'). Presentation metadata that does not affect schedule evaluation.

valid_from.description: The first local civil date to which this exception applies, interpreted in the containing Location's `timezone`.

valid_through.description: The last local civil date to which this exception applies, interpreted in the containing Location's `timezone`.
